item.title: Vaishnavi’s Dream Run Ends With Runner-up Finish At ITF W100 Bengaluru
item.description: KPB Trust ITF Women: Third seed and World No. 124 Hanne Vandewinkel of Belgium finished a stellar week with a 6-0, 6-1 win against wildcard Vaishnavi Adkar in the final of the KPB Trust ITF Women’s Open W100 Bengaluru 2026.

item.title: South Africa End India’s 12-Match T20 World Cup Streak, Leave Semifinal Hopes Hanging
item.description: South Africa’s 76-run win over India in the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup Super Eights ends India’s 12-match winning streak and puts their semifinal chances in jeopardy.

item.title: Tripura CM Urges Students, Youths To Embrace Sports and Studies
item.description: Tripura Chief Minister Manik Saha: Tripura Chief Minister Manik Saha has urged students and youths to actively take up sports alongside their studies, saying that the state government is giving top priority to the development of sports infrastructure to improve the overall quality of sports in the state.

item.title: Sri Lanka Must Do It the “Hard Way” After England Defeat, Says Batting Coach
item.description: Sri Lanka face an uphill battle to reach the T20 World Cup semi-finals after a heavy loss to England, with coach Vikram Rathour admitting they must win both remaining Super Eight games.

item.title: Four-day Khelo India Winter Games Begin In J&K;’s Gulmarg Today
item.description: Khelo India Winter Games: All arrangements were in place on Monday for the inauguration of the 6th Khelo India Winter Games (KIWG) at this picturesque snow-clad ski resort of Jammu and Kashmir.

item.title: Sebastian Korda Claims Third ATP Tour Title With Delray Beach Open Crown
item.description: Sebastian Korda captured the third ATP Tour title of his career, producing a composed performance to defeat fellow American Tommy Paul 6-4, 6-3 in the final of the Delray Beach Open.

item.title: Arsenal Thrash Spurs To Keep Five-point Premier League Lead
item.description: Randal Kolo Muani: Arsenal produced a dominant display to retain its five-point lead at the top of the Premier League and ease talk of late-season nerves with a 4-1 win away to Tottenham Hotspur in the north London derby.

item.title: T20 WC: Gavaskar Questions India’s Approach For 'simply Throwing Bat At Everything' After 76-run Thrashing By SA
item.description: T20 World Cup: After India slumped to a crushing 76-run defeat against South Africa in their Super Eights clash of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on Sunday, former India great Sunil Gavaskar highlighted a clear difference in strategy between the two teams, noting that the Proteas demonstrated adaptability that India could not showcase.

item.title: Etcheverry Clinches First ATP Title In Rio De Janeiro
item.description: Tomas Martin Etcheverry: Tomas Martin Etcheverry captured his maiden ATP Tour title at the Rio Open a 3-6, 7-6(3), 6-4 championship-match victory against Alejandro Tabilo.

item.title: T20 WC: 'Lost But Will Bounce Back,' Says BCCI Secy Saikia After India’s Super 8s Loss To SA
item.description: BCCI Secy Saikia: After India suffered a heavy 76-run loss to South Africa in their Super Eights clash of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup at the Narendra Modi Stadium in Ahmedabad on Sunday, Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) secretary Devajit Saikia voiced confidence that the defending champions will recover quickly from the setback.
